title: The tarp, folded, 2022
logline: The lawn chair's tarp folded on the dock in July with a stone on it, the chair in use beyond — Maria's braid over its back from behind. The page draws the fold and the stone and lets the braid be the person.

panels.composition: A folded blue tarp on dock planks with a stone on it, and beyond it an old lawn chair from behind with a gray braid over its back, the bay.

characters.pose: a braid over the chair's back

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a folded blue tarp on wooden dock planks with a stone on it and beyond it an old lawn chair seen from behind with a gray braid over its back, a bay beyond, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
